profile.headline: Software Engineer | PharmD | Ex-Twitter
profile.summary:
Backend software engineer in core services at Twitter. Skilled in Scala, Java, and React.JS

I love spending time outdoors, gardening, discovering the neighborhood's hidden gems, and brewing a perfect cup of joe.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer @ Core Services (Users team)

- build and maintain User related services and offline jobs
- provide support to power a fast, highly-available, high-throughput service abstraction for user data
- work in a partnership between Users team and Health team to build a new service that will enable new entities within Twitter to launch quickly by utilizing a common platform
- deliver hosted visibility filtering to the Product Entity Platform, accelerating feature development by reducing the time to apply VF to new entity from greater than one quarter
- support building the next generation of user-related features across Twitter products

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer- Crypto Trading Simulator
positions.description:
-Designed a trading simulator that enables users to buy and sell cryptocurrency in real-time to play out investment strategies with virtual portfolio
- Displayed a list of cryptocurrency and prices in current market by integrating web API using Axios hooks
- Generated interactive visualizations with Chart.js library for intuitive line chart depicting one year historical price data

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer- Brewery Finder
positions.description:
- Developed web app for finding local craft breweries using React and styled-components to deliver modular UI/UX
- Utilized BreweryDB API to get a list of breweries’ information and location which then was used to pin results onto map using Google Maps API

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer- Virtual Pillbox
positions.description:
- Implemented React app for patients to record current medications, view dosing schedules, and look up medication informations
- Used React Hook Form to support CRUD operation, implement validation, and increase performance
- Handled stateful logic using React Hooks
- Built API server using json-server to support RESTful CRUD operations

positions.title: Specialty pharmacist
positions.description:
- Oversee disease education and adherence programs for specialty medications in oncology, transplant, autoimmune, HIV/AIDS, and endocrine disorders
- Ensure the accurate delivery of pharmaceutical care services by implementing drug therapy monitoring, patient education, drug information and chronic disease state management
- Recommend therapy plans with respect to patients’ acute and chronic disease states and overall health concerns
- Perform drug utilization review (DUR) and medication reconciliation quarterly for members in clinical programs
- Assist providers with prior authorization and appeal process
- Utilize Salesforce CRM to learn physician prescribing behavior and streamline prescription management
- Demonstrate the highest standards of care to earn and maintain Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation by URAC and ACHC

positions.title: Staff Pharmacist
positions.description:
-Counsel patients on new prescriptions, medication adherence, proper monitoring techniques, and medication-related adverse effects
-Administer vaccines to qualifying individuals and provide necessary education
-Comply with state and federal drug laws to provide appropriate medical care within legal
limits

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
